# ES7210 initialization reference

The fixed-rate initialization in `firmware/src/board_audio.cpp` is adapted from Espressif's [esp_codec_dev ES7210 driver](https://github.com/espressif/esp-adf/blob/release/v2.x/components/esp_codec_dev/device/es7210/es7210.c).

SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

The adaptation uses Arduino Wire, two microphones in ordinary 16-bit stereo I2S at 16 kHz, 4.096 MHz MCLK, and 24 dB analog gain. It selects one microphone for the mono network stream. The third ADC input is the board's speaker reference and is disabled; this firmware does not implement acoustic echo cancellation or beamforming. The full [Apache 2.0 license](es8311/LICENSE) is included.
